channel.title: QUAD Academy Blog
channel.description: CBSE Class 10 Maths and Science board-exam prep from QUAD Academy.

item.title: Carbon and its Compounds: 7 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 4)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 4 solved: homologous series, soap micelles, isomers, conductivity, glacial acetic acid, identify-the-compound and why carbon shares electrons.

item.title: Coordinate Geometry: 6 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 7)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 7 solved: distance formula, equidistant points, proving a square, section formula, ratio from an axis and the parallelogram trick, with marking tips.

item.title: Introduction to Trigonometry: 5 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 8)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 8 solved: one ratio to all six, standard-angle values, finding A and B, and identity proofs, with marking tips and common traps.

item.title: Heights and Distances: 4 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 9)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 9 Some Applications of Trigonometry solved: kite string, walking towards a tower, two ships from a lighthouse, building and tower.

item.title: How to Use Previous-Year Questions the Smart Way (Class 10)
item.description: A seven-step method for using CBSE Class 10 previous-year questions properly: sort by type, pause and try, mark mistakes in three colours, keep an error list and practise under time.

item.title: Chemical Reactions and Equations: 3 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Science)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 1 board questions solved step by step: heating lead nitrate, the barium chloride precipitation reaction, and the oxidising-agent trap, with marking tips.
